    visited = set()

        visited.add(node)
        if node == goal:
            path.append(goal)
            path.append(start)
            path.reverse()
            return True
        for neighbour in graph[node]:
            if neighbour not in visited:
                path.append(node)
                if search(neighbour):
                    return True
                path.pop()
        return False
    search(start)
    return path if path else None
